external_primary_research.finding: PipeWire clients connect to the daemon through the native socket, by default $XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/pipewire-0; session manager is a separate client.
pipewire-pulse is the PulseAudio-compatible daemon integrated with PipeWire and uses XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/PULSE_RUNTIME_PATH for the Pulse socket.

WirePlumber is normally a systemd user service but can be run independently/by hand after PipeWire; a desktop user manager is not intrinsically required for a bounded headless sandbox process topology.
Ubuntu 24.04 Noble provides pipewire-bin, pipewire-pulse and wireplumber packages; package versions must be captured from the actual sandbox install rather than inferred from this packet.
